message.content:
**Element:** A subtle, glowing **border/outline** (or shadow) surrounding the entire main content area (the list of appointments).

**Location:** It forms the rectangular frame that encloses all four appointment entries and the header buttons ("وقت النظافة" and "إضافة نظافة"). It is most visible along the top edge of this container.

**Estimated Hex Color:** **#2a3b3c** (This is a very dark teal/cyan color. While it has a slight cool/blue tint that might be perceived as having a tiny hint of violet in certain lighting or on specific screens, it is technically a dark cyan/teal. There are no distinctly purple, violet, or lavender elements in this image).
